messages:
jordan: Quick heads-up — FinHealth (prospect) just sent a SIG/CAIQ follow-up asking specifically for IAM/access-control evidence: SSO/SAML metadata, MFA enforcement proof, RBAC role mappings, SCIM provisioning sample, service account controls, session timeout policy, emergency admin procedures, and audit log export. Can we compile? Need to hand to customer by Tue EOD.

samira: We can. Quick checklist to include:
- SAML metadata XML
- SSO integration guide screenshot(s)
- MFA policy screenshot + policy id
- RBAC mapping doc (IdP groups -> Redwood roles)
- SCIM examples (group sync, user create)
- Service account policy + sample terraform snippet
- Audit/log export (last 90d) + retention policy
I'll redact user PII before share.

emily: Artifacts live in: s3://redwood-sec/evidence-packages/prod/ (access-controlled). I'll bundle SAML metadata and RBAC mapping. For the SAML SP config here's the relevant snippet we can show (no secrets):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://api.redwood.ai/saml/metadata">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://api.redwood.ai/auth/saml/callback"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Session timeout is enforced via policy: default 60m idle, configurable per org.

mike: Do we support mapping IdP groups to multiple Redwood roles (e.g., dev -> deploy, sec -> audit)? Also SCIM group sync cadence?

emily: Yes — group-to-role mapping supported. Example mapping (we'll include CSV):
IdP_Group,Redwood_Role
finhealth-admin,admin
finhealth-dev,developer
finhealth-readonly,viewer
SCIM supports group sync + user provisioning; default sync interval 15m, can be on-demand via SCIM PATCH.

okta-bot: SSO connection created for FinHealth (conn-id: sc-ff-2026). MFA policy attached: PolicyID=poli_8421.

samira: For MFA enforcement proof we can provide a screenshot of the Okta policy + the system log showing policy enforcement events (sanitized). For service accounts, include our "service-account-minimum-privilege" doc and a sample Terraform snippet (no keys):
```hcl
resource "redwood_service_account" "ci" {
  name = "ci-bot"
  roles = ["ingest", "model.run"]
  max_token_ttl = "8h"
}
```
Also include emergency access runbook and JIT admin flow (approval workflow screenshot).

jordan: Awesome. Can someone confirm names of the files you'll hand over so I can put them in the response email? Also need confirmation: do we assert MFA is enforced for all interactive logins (yes/no)

emily: File list I'll produce:
- redwood_saml_metadata.xml
- okta_mfa_policy.png
- rbac_group_mapping.csv
- scim_examples.json
- service_account_policy.md
- audit_export_90d.csv (redacted)
MFA enforced for all interactive user logins: yes (enforced at IdP level + we block token issuance without MFA claim).

mike: I'll compile the zip, run redaction, and upload to the secure share. ETA: Mon 5pm PT. @jordan please confirm if Tue EOD works for FinHealth.

jordan: Tue EOD is fine. Please include a short readme mapping each artifact to the question in the SIG/CAIQ. Thanks team :thumbsup:
